jina: Freedom to participate in public affairs
maudhui: (1) Subject to the provisions of Articles 5, 39 and 67 of this Constitution and of the laws of the land in connection with the conditions for electing and being elected or appointing and participating in public affairs, every citizen of the United Republic is entitled to take part in matters pertaining to the governance of the country, either directly or through representatives freely elected by the people, in conformity with the procedures laid down by, or in accordance with, the law. (2) Every citizen has the right and the freedom to participate fully in the process leading to the decision on matters affecting him, his well-being or the nation.
